questions.text: What is the task class?
questions.why: The model set (turbulence, species, radiation, multiphase) and the rule recommendations depend on the task class

questions.text: What is the problem dimensionality?
questions.why: The dimensionality is set when starting Fluent (3ddp/2ddp) and determines the available models and the axis zone type

questions.text: Short case name (Latin letters, no spaces)?
questions.why: Used in .cas.h5/.dat.h5 and report file names; the name must be a valid file name

questions.text: Is the problem axisymmetric (a body of revolution)?
questions.why: Axisymmetry requires a 2D axisymmetric setup and an axis-type zone; the chain is not verified in the KB

questions.text: Describe the problem in one sentence (what is computed, what is the goal)?
questions.why: Context helps choose the models correctly and interpret the results

questions.text: Specify the mesh file (.msh) or case (.cas.h5).
questions.why: Without a mesh Fluent does not open the models/BC menus; the first mesh is read via /file/read-case

questions.text: In what units is the mesh geometry defined?
questions.why: The need for /mesh/scale depends on the units; the arguments of that command are not verified in the KB — the scale must be confirmed

questions.text: Confirm the scale factors converting to meters (x, y, z).
questions.why: KB: /mesh/scale is not verified, the number and order of arguments are unknown (requires_verification); without a confirmed scale the geometry and BCs will be wrong

questions.text: Check the mesh after reading (/mesh/check and /mesh/quality)?
questions.why: The check takes seconds and reveals holes/negative volumes before the run

questions.text: Do you need to append additional meshes (e.g. a solid region for CHT)?
questions.why: Appending a second mesh (/mesh/modify-zones append-mesh) changes the zone composition; the order of zone-name/zone-type depends on it

questions.text: What is the characteristic Mach number?
questions.why: Mach >= 0.3 is the threshold above which density-based-implicit, energy and compressible properties are recommended

questions.text: Is the flow compressible (a gas with a noticeable density change)?
questions.why: Affects the choice of solver and of the material density method (ideal-gas)

questions.text: What is the characteristic Reynolds number?
questions.why: The threshold Re = 5000 (as in the verified working journal) switches laminar ↔ k-omega SST

questions.text: What is the characteristic flow velocity, m/s?
questions.why: Needed to estimate Re and choose the inlet BC (velocity-inlet is possible only after the chain is verified)

questions.text: Does the problem involve heat transfer (heating/cooling, temperature matters)?
questions.why: If yes, the energy equation is enabled; without it the temperature is not solved and thermal BCs are unavailable

questions.text: What is the maximum temperature in the problem, K?
questions.why: At T >= ~1000 K radiation (Discrete Ordinates) is recommended and energy is mandatory

questions.text: Should radiation be taken into account?
questions.why: Radiation adds optical material properties and requires energy; DO is the main option for combustion/furnaces

questions.text: Which radiation model is preferable?
questions.why: DO is verified for combustion/furnaces; S2S is surfaces only without a participating medium; P1 is cheaper but poor for optically thin media

questions.text: Is there combustion or chemical reactions?
questions.why: Requires Species Transport, a mixture material and a reaction mechanism; changes the equation set and the BCs

questions.text: Specify the mechanism/material database file (.src) with reactions.
questions.why: The mechanism is imported via /define/materials/data-base database-type user-defined; without it species-transport will not turn on

questions.text: What is the name of the mixture material from the mechanism?
questions.why: The mixture material name is passed as the second argument to species-transport (e.g. mixture-material)

questions.text: Enable volumetric reactions and stiff chemistry?
questions.why: Detailed mechanisms need the stiff integrator; without volumetric reactions no sources appear

questions.text: Are there several phases (liquid-gas, bubbles, droplets, boiling)?
questions.why: Multiphase models change the equation set and require special BCs; they are incompatible with a number of models

questions.text: Which multiphase model is suitable?
questions.why: VOF — sharp interfaces; Eulerian — dense dispersed flows; Mixture — weakly coupled phases; wetsteam — steam/condensate

questions.text: How many phases?
questions.why: The number of phases is set after choosing the model (/define/models/multiphase/number-of-phases)

questions.text: Do you need to model particles/droplets (discrete phase, DPM)?
questions.why: DPM is activated by creating an injection; it requires a mesh and often two-way coupling with the gas

questions.text: Characteristic particle diameter, m?
questions.why: Determines particle inertia and the choice of drag law; in profile cases it is set via a UDF

questions.text: Account for the back-influence of particles on the gas (two-way coupling)?
questions.why: With a noticeable particle mass fraction, one-way coupling is not enough

questions.text: Do you need user-defined functions (UDFs)?
questions.why: UDFs are compiled into a library and bound by hooks; they affect properties, sources, initialization

questions.text: List the UDF .c files.
questions.why: All files must compile into one library; the names must not contain spaces (compile.js does not escape them)

questions.text: UDF library name (Latin letters, no spaces)?
questions.why: The library name is used in compile/load and in the hook line <function>::<library>

questions.text: Which hooks need to be bound?
questions.why: Hooks (initialization, volume-reaction-rate, etc.) are bound after load; the function-hooks submenu appears only with a loaded library

questions.text: What is the current/working material (fluid)?
questions.why: The material is assigned to zones; its properties determine the thermophysics (density, Cp, viscosity)

questions.text: Which density method for the gas?
questions.why: ideal-gas is mandatory for compressible cases and automatically enables energy; a verified journal form exists

questions.text: Which mixture material to use (for species/combustion)?
questions.why: The mixture must be imported from a .src; its name goes into species-transport

questions.text: Specify the user material database (.src), if needed.
questions.why: The .src is imported via database-type user-defined; without it there is no mixture material and no mechanism

questions.text: What is the inlet boundary type?
questions.why: The type is set via zone-type; the velocity/pressure-inlet chains are not verified in the KB — they will not go into the journal without verification

questions.text: Mass flow rate at the inlet, kg/s?
questions.why: One of the main mass-flow-inlet inputs; in profile cases it is set as a Named Expression

questions.text: Inlet temperature, K?
questions.why: Thermal inlet BC; available after the energy equation is enabled

questions.text: Turbulence intensity at the inlet, %?
questions.why: The verified working journal uses 10% and viscosity ratio 30 (verified mass-flow-inlet line)

questions.text: Turbulent viscosity ratio at the inlet?
questions.why: Pairs with the turbulence intensity; 30 is the value from the verified journal

questions.text: What is the outlet boundary type?
questions.why: The pressure-outlet chain was not walked in the KB (depends on models) — without verification the step goes to requires_verification

questions.text: Gauge pressure at the outlet, Pa?
questions.why: The main pressure-outlet parameter; the operating pressure is set in /define/operating-conditions

questions.text: Thermal conditions at the wall?
questions.why: The wall thermal branch is only partially verified in the KB (the working line with radiation exists, the question texts were not captured)

questions.text: Wall temperature, K (if specified)?
questions.why: Used when thermal condition = temperature; requires the energy equation

questions.text: Is there a porous zone?
questions.why: A porous medium is set in the fluid zone by a 55-step chain; the full decoding of the arguments is missing from the KB

questions.text: Which solver to use?
questions.why: pressure-based for incompressible, density-based-implicit for Mach >= 0.3; explicit requires a separate check

questions.text: Pressure-velocity coupling scheme (for pressure-based)?
questions.why: Codes verified: SIMPLE=20, SIMPLEC=21, PISO=22, Coupled=24; a new case defaults to Coupled

questions.text: How many iterations to run per launch?
questions.why: The default iteration count; stopping is additionally by convergence criteria and reporting-interval

questions.text: How to initialize the solution?
questions.why: Hybrid initialization is verified; standard (initialize-flow) is confirmed only by the user journal and is marked blocked in the KB

questions.text: On what basis should the run stop?
questions.why: In the working project stopping is combined: residuals + report criteria; iterations only — risk of under/over-solving

questions.text: Residual thresholds per equation (continuity, x/y/z-velocity, energy)?
questions.why: The number of values must match the number of equations; the order is: continuity, x/y/z-velocity, energy

questions.text: Report-based stopping threshold (e.g. by the average outlet temperature)?
questions.why: conv-reports/add: stop-criterion; strict 1e-3, relaxed 5e-3

questions.text: How often to check convergence (every N iterations)?
questions.why: The check is less frequent than the history write (e.g. 100 and 50) so that the criterion relies on recorded values

questions.text: Where to write the report history (.out)?
questions.why: report-files writes report definition values every N iterations; the directory must exist

questions.text: Build report history plots (report-plots)?
questions.why: In batch (-g) the plot is not displayed, but the object is created; reportDefs is not passed by the engine yet

questions.text: Which fields to export in the ASCII export?
questions.why: Fields are passed positionally in /file/export/ascii; the names are internal (temperature, pressure, heat-flux, ...)

questions.text: From which surfaces/zones to export the fields?
questions.why: The surface list is the second argument of /file/export/ascii; the surfaces must exist

questions.text: Auto-save the case/data during the run?
questions.why: Protects a long run; but the working /file/auto-save syntax was NOT found in the KB (requires_verification) — without verification the step will not go into the journal

questions.text: How often to save (every N iterations)?
questions.why: data-frequency is a numeric increment (in 2026 R1), but the exact command form is not verified

questions.text: How many recent files to keep?
questions.why: retain-most-recent-files; older files are deleted on overflow

questions.text: Where to store backups and results?
questions.why: A separate directory (archive/) protects the results from being overwritten on a re-run

questions.text: How many threads/processes to use?
questions.why: Set at launch (fluent -tN); more cores speed up the run but require license and memory

questions.text: Which MPI to use?
questions.why: The project uses -mpi=intel; a local run without MPI — none

questions.text: Describe the run stages (iterations, FR/expression sweeps) if there are several.
questions.why: run.stages is used by the compiler for the /solve/iterate sequence; FR sweep is profile logic
